subject: Operations
title: Job Design
description: A quick, practical guide to Job Design.

hook.text: Henry Ford split car assembly into 84 tiny steps. Workers got fast—but hated the monotony.

buildup.text: Job design decides what tasks a role includes, how much variety it offers, and how much autonomy.

discovery.text: Specialization boosts speed. Enlargement adds variety. Enrichment adds decision-making power.

twist.text: Ultra-specialized jobs cause burnout and turnover—replacing workers costs more than the speed gains.

climax.text: Modern operations design jobs for both efficiency and human satisfaction—because both affect output.

punchline.text: Design the job for the human, not just the task.

quiz.question: What does job enrichment add to a role?
